component.name: Talis
component.summary: An interactive, animated and music-aware desktop turntable

description.p: An interactive music-aware turntable wallpaper for the Linux desktop with animated mechanical parts and music playback controls.
Includes day and night scenes at resolutions up to 4K.
Improves OpenGL startup compatibility and GTK presentation, keeps Hyprland bar overlays visible, and adds a saved Wayland desktop layer setting.
